hook: Some frugal habits genuinely build wealth. Others waste your time, your health or even your money. In this video I go through 20 frugal habits that actually make you rich and 10 that don't, from three angles: the big-number habits that move hundreds of thousands of dollars, the frugal traps our brains love, and the playbook that makes good frugality automatic.
